title: Garlicky Saffron Rice
description: Golden, fragrant long-grain rice simmered with saffron, shallots, plenty of garlic, carrot and sweet peas. A one-pot Spanish side that dresses up fish, chicken or beans.

title: Spanish Garlic Cabbage Salad (Ensalada de Col Andaluza)
description: Shredded cabbage tossed with sizzling garlic-infused olive oil, sherry vinegar, smoked paprika and cumin. Warm, tangy and mayo-free, a smart alternative to coleslaw.

title: Spanish Pisto Andaluz
description: Spain's answer to ratatouille: peppers, zucchini, onion, potato and tomatoes slowly stewed in olive oil with smoked paprika. Spoon it beside grilled meats, fish or a pile of rice.

title: Vegan Southern Collard Greens
description: Thinly sliced collards braised with garlic, juicy tomatoes and smoked paprika for a smoky, savory pot of greens without any ham hock.
swaps: Use tamari (gluten-free) rather than soy sauce.

title: Maple Roasted Brussels Sprouts & Carrots
description: Brussels sprouts, carrots and red onion roasted until caramelized with maple, smoked paprika and a hint of cayenne, finished with crunchy pumpkin seeds.

title: Vegan Kale Caesar Salad
description: Romaine and kale tossed in a creamy, briny Caesar dressing made from sunflower seeds, capers and nutritional yeast, topped with spiced crispy chickpeas instead of croutons. Totally egg-, dairy- and nut-free.
watch: Vegan Worcestershire sauce can contain soy sauce made with wheat or malt vinegar; pick a gluten-free, malt-free brand. Soak sunflower seeds ahead.

title: Jamaican Coleslaw
description: Creamy Caribbean-style slaw of cabbage, carrot, chayote (cho cho) and red pepper with lime, celery seed and mustard. The classic partner for jerk dishes and rice and peas.
watch: Use an egg-free, nut-free vegan mayonnaise (some vegan mayos are cashew- or almond-based).

title: Vegan Cuban Black Beans (Frijoles Negros)
description: Dried black beans simmered low and slow with a sofrito of onion, green pepper and garlic, cumin and oregano, then brightened with a splash of vinegar. Rich, saucy and perfect over white rice.

title: Jamaican Coconut Rice
description: Basmati brown rice cooked in coconut milk and creamed coconut with thyme sprigs, garlic, onion and pimento berries for a fragrant Instant Pot side.

title: Garlic Hasselback Potatoes with Sage
description: Potatoes sliced accordion-style and roasted with garlic oil and crisp sage leaves until the edges fan out golden and crunchy. Showy but simple.

title: Classic Vegan Stuffing (Gluten-Free)
description: Old-fashioned sage-and-onion stuffing made with chunky bread, celery and broth, no eggs needed. Bake it in a dish for crisp edges alongside a holiday roast.
swaps: Use gluten-free, egg-free bread; olive oil (or a nut-free vegan butter) instead of vegan butter.
watch: Many gluten-free breads contain egg; check labels. Use gluten-free vegetable broth.

title: Vegan Green Bean Casserole (Gluten-Free)
description: Green beans and mushrooms baked in a creamy, from-scratch soy-milk sauce seasoned with Dijon and sage, topped with crispy onions and gluten-free panko.
watch: Check that the gluten-free panko is egg-free.

title: Vegan Cranberry Sauce
description: Fresh cranberries simmered with orange juice, zest, cinnamon and maple syrup into a glossy, sweet-tart sauce. Make it days ahead.

title: Sautéed Spinach with Garlic
description: Baby spinach wilted in olive oil with garlic in just a few minutes. The fastest green side for any weeknight plate.

title: Tostones (Fried Green Plantains)
description: Green plantains fried, smashed flat and fried again until crisp and golden, then showered with flaky salt. Great with mojo or guacamole.
swaps: Make the mayo-ketchup dip with egg-free mayonnaise, or serve with guacamole instead.

title: French Potato Salad
description: Baby potatoes soaked in a bright Dijon-shallot vinaigrette with white wine and loads of tarragon, parsley and chives. Mayo-free and picnic-proof.

title: Balsamic Roasted Carrots
description: Carrots roasted with Italian herbs, then glazed with balsamic and honey until sticky and caramelized.
swaps: Swap the butter for olive oil or a nut-free vegan butter.

title: Sauteed Bok Choy with Garlic
description: Halved bok choy seared until lightly charred, then tossed with ginger, garlic and a splash of savory sauce. A ten-minute Asian green.
swaps: Use tamari instead of soy sauce; use canola or avocado oil (not peanut).

title: German Potato Salad
description: Warm red potatoes tossed in a tangy bacon, cider-vinegar and whole-grain mustard dressing with red onion and celery.
watch: Choose gluten-free bacon; check mustard for malt vinegar.

title: Braised Red Cabbage
description: Ruby cabbage gently braised with apples, onion, red wine vinegar and brown sugar until silky and sweet-sour. Lovely with pork or roasts.
swaps: Use olive oil or a nut-free vegan butter instead of butter.

title: Chinese Cucumber Salad
description: Crunchy salted cucumbers dressed with a hot garlic oil, rice vinegar and a whisper of sesame oil. Cool, punchy and soy-sauce-free.

title: Cilantro Lime Quinoa Salad
description: Fluffy quinoa, white beans, cucumber and red onion tossed in a zesty blended cilantro-lime dressing. Hearty enough to carry a light dinner.
swaps: Use the olive-oil option in the dressing (or a dairy-free, nut-free yogurt such as soy or coconut).

title: Oven-Roasted Potatoes and Asparagus
description: Yellow potatoes and asparagus roasted together with garlic, onion powder and fresh rosemary on one pan.

title: Cilantro Lime Rice
description: Jasmine or basmati rice cooked with garlic, then folded with lime zest, juice and fresh cilantro. A bright, burrito-bowl-style side.
watch: Use gluten-free broth if cooking in broth.

title: Mexican Rice 2.0
description: Toasted white rice simmered in a blended sauce of tomatoes, tomatillos, onion, garlic and jalapeño for a tangy, restaurant-style arroz.
watch: Use a gluten-free vegetable or chicken stock.

title: Classic Creamy Coleslaw
description: Green and red cabbage, carrot and green onion in a lemony, lightly sweet creamy dressing. The classic BBQ side.

title: Curry Roasted Cauliflower
description: Cauliflower florets roasted with olive oil, lemon, curry powder and cumin until browned and tender.
swaps: Skip the optional Spike seasoning or use plain salt.

title: Easy Ratatouille
description: Eggplant, zucchini, peppers and tomatoes simmered with garlic, thyme and basil into a rustic Provençal stew of vegetables.

title: Easy Thai Coconut Rice
description: Jasmine rice simmered in coconut milk and a pinch of salt for a lightly rich, fragrant rice that tames spicy curries.

title: Coconut Creamed Spinach
description: Spinach, shallot and garlic bathed in a silky coconut-milk sauce thickened with arrowroot and brightened with lemon. Steakhouse comfort with no dairy.

title: Quinoa Tabbouleh
description: A gluten-free take on tabbouleh with quinoa, cucumber, cherry tomatoes and loads of parsley and mint in a lemon-garlic dressing.

title: Creamy Polenta
description: Stone-ground polenta simmered in broth and milk with garlic until soft and spoonable, then finished with basil. A cozy base for braises and ragù.
swaps: Use oat or soy milk (not almond); nutritional yeast instead of Parmesan; nut-free vegan butter or olive oil.
watch: Use gluten-free vegetable broth; check polenta is certified gluten-free.
